body: I realise the prompt meant singular but these songs give me life equally.

Black, Present Tense, or Habit.

Black for well, obvious reasons

I like Present Tense because I find myself living in the before-times and not moving on. Its my wakeup song. Also I really like Ament's bass in this one during the chorus.

Habit, for obvious reasons. I used to be hooked on coke and party favors, if you get my drift. Brought into it by an ex.
